The '''Visdic territories''' were a region<ref name="DB" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Uyter/Legends|Uyter]]. They were the home region of [[Malé-Dee/Legends|Malé-Dee]], who represented Uyter in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] following the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of its previous [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], [[Lexi Dio/Legends|Lexi Dio]].<ref name="DB" /> The territories shared their name with the [[Visdic body wrappings]] which Malé-Dee wore while in the Senate.<ref name="ROTS Scrapbook">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Scrapbook]]''</ref>
